digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review documentation and CLI explain seam
propositions: Authors cannot easily discover how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate; existing material is either gate-mechanics or reviewer-facing criterion registry with no concise author-facing on-ramp.
AGENTS.md incorrectly points authors at the criterion registry for the plan description template instead of author-facing documentation.
No comparable on-ramp guidance exists for the code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified).
The CLI `rebar explain` seam must be extended to route guide names (plan, review) alongside criterion IDs through the shared registry lookup for discovery across CLI, MCP, and library surfaces.
New top-level docs files must be linked from docs/README.md to keep the docs-index CI gate passing.
